description:
Outcome: coordinator can operate reliable private service, from brief.md Constraints and persistent workflows.
Scope: staging/env/access audit, backup/restore rehearsal, secret management, email monitoring/retry, household corrections, retention proposal, operating instructions and real season/timezone/digest configuration. Excludes: map, unapproved purchases and live email without deployment authorization.
Acceptance: staging journeys work; restored data preserves invariants; failed email recoverable; contacts unavailable to gardeners/logs; coordinator can follow runbook.
Behaviour: observable secret-safe failures; restored email state reconciles against provider to avoid duplicate sends.
Verification: staging authorization audit and restore/delivery failure drill. Prerequisites: allocation view, resolution and daily email. Assumptions: owner supplies deployment access; retention finalized before live use, no invented legal requirements.
title: Deployment, recovery and privacy readiness
